name: Adobe
description: Use Adobe creative tools (Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, Firefly, Express, Stock) to generate and edit images and designs.
notes: Remote MCP is 'Adobe for creativity' (Adobe IMS OAuth); URL from mcpservers.org listing, verified by probe. Firefly Services API requires OAuth client credentials plus x-api-key (client ID). No official end-user npm MCP (only @adobe/express-developer-mcp for add-on devs).

name: Affonso
description: Manage an affiliate program: affiliates, referrals, commissions and payouts.
notes: Docs: MCP accepts Bearer API key, OAuth 2.1 also supported. Only @affonso/sdk and @affonso/cli on npm, no MCP package.

name: AgentKey
description: Query live web search, scraping, social media and crypto/on-chain data from many providers through one API key.
notes: AgentKey by Chainbase (agentkey.app). npm package repo github.com/chainbase-labs/agentkey-server; base URL and Bearer header read from package source. No hosted MCP URL found; no public API reference page found (docs = homepage).

name: AgentMail
description: Create email inboxes for agents and send, receive, list and reply to email messages and threads.
notes: npm package is a bridge to the hosted server (sends key as x-api-key); optional --file-root and --tools args.

name: Agnost AI
description: Query analytics on your MCP servers and agents: tool calls, errors, intents and conversations.
notes: Hosted MCP documented at docs.agnost.ai (Google sign-in via OAuth). npm 'agnost' is the tracking SDK, not an MCP server. No public REST API with API key found.

name: Ahrefs
description: Research keywords, backlinks, organic traffic, rankings and competitor domains with Ahrefs SEO data.
notes: npm maintainers include an ahrefs.com account (no repository field). Local package env var is literally API_KEY. API access requires an Enterprise-level plan / API units.

name: Airtable
description: Read and write records, tables and bases in Airtable.
notes: npm airtable-mcp-server is community (domdomegg). @airtable/mcp-cli is official but is a CLI client for the hosted server, not a stdio MCP server.

name: Algolia
description: Search, browse and manage Algolia indices, records, settings and analytics.

notes: Basic auth = API key:secret key (also AMPLITUDE_SECRET_KEY). EU region uses analytics.eu.amplitude.com. @amplitude/mcp-analytics is an SDK for instrumenting MCP servers, not an Amplitude MCP.

secrets.label: API base URL of your account

name: Attio

name: Autodesk

notes: No hosted MCP URL found; official open-source server github.com/autodesk-platform-services/aps-mcp-server-nodejs runs locally (not on npm). APS API is OAuth 2 only (also AUTODESK_CLIENT_SECRET).

name: Amazon Web Services
description: Search AWS documentation and best practices, and operate AWS resources and APIs.
notes: AWS Knowledge MCP is docs-only and needs no auth. The managed AWS MCP Server https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp (probe 200, serverInfo AWSMCP) requires SigV4 IAM credentials via mcp-proxy-for-aws. awslabs MCP servers are Python (uvx), not npm. AWS APIs use SigV4 signing, so no simple key-header api entry.

name: Bitly

notes: Base URL, header and MCP URL from docs.brandsearch.co/llms.txt.

name: Brex

notes: Remote URL from mcp.so listing, verified by probe (Brex OAuth). npm mcp-brex is community (dennisonbertram).

name: Browser Use

notes: Docs: MCP key goes in x-browser-use-api-key header (not Bearer); initialize answered without key. npm package published by a browser-use.com maintainer (no repo field).

name: Buffer

notes: No official npm MCP.

name: Canny

notes: No official Canny MCP found (mcp.canny.io 404). npm package is by MailerLite (third party). Canny API takes apiKey as a request parameter (POST body/form).

secrets.label: API base URL of your account

notes: Hosted MCP accepts OAuth or API key headers. CLOUDINARY_URL=cloudinary://API_KEY:API_SECRET@CLOUD_NAME (or CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME/API_KEY/API_SECRET).

name: CockroachDB

notes: No official npm MCP.

notes: Works anonymously at low rate limits; Bearer API key or OAuth raises limits. npm can also take --api-key arg.

notes: No hosted MCP; falcon-mcp (github.com/CrowdStrike/falcon-mcp) is a Python package, not npm. API uses OAuth2 client credentials (FALCON_CLIENT_ID/FALCON_CLIENT_SECRET); base URL varies by cloud region.

name: Crypto.com

notes: Remote MCP is public market data only, no auth. Exchange public endpoints need no key; private endpoints are HMAC-SHA256 signed (api_key + sig in JSON body), so auth is null (no simple header scheme).

name: DataForSEO
description: Pull SERP results, keyword volumes, backlinks, on-page audits and domain analytics data for SEO research.
notes: Basic auth uses API login + API password (DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD); DATAFORSEO_USERNAME accepted as alias by the npm server. Remote MCP URL inferred and probe-verified (OAuth).

name: dbt

secrets.label: Service or personal access token

notes: Remote MCP host is region/account specific (cloud.getdbt.com for US multi-tenant); dbt also documents service-token auth with x-dbt-prod-environment-id headers. Official local server is Python (uvx dbt-mcp); npm 'dbt-mcp' is an unrelated third-party package.

name: Deel

name: Descript

secrets.label: API token
secrets.help: Descript app settings > API tokens > Create token (token is tied to one Drive)

description: Read and send messages, manage channels, roles and members in Discord servers.

secrets.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.label: Bot token
secrets.help: discord.com/developers/applications > your app > Bot > Reset Token

notes: REST header value is 'Bot <token>'. mcp.discord.com is live and its OAuth metadata names https://discord.com as authorization server (user-scoped OAuth), but no public Discord docs page for it was found. No official npm package (community servers only).

name: Docusign
description: Create and send envelopes for e-signature, track signing status and manage agreements and templates.
notes: MCP returns 403 without www-authenticate, but OAuth protected-resource metadata confirms it; treat as OAuth. eSignature REST requires OAuth (auth code or JWT grant); production base URI is account-specific (from /oauth/userinfo).

name: DoorDash

secrets.label: Developer ID, Key ID and Signing Secret (JWT)

name: Dropbox
description: Search, read, upload, move and share files and folders in Dropbox.
notes: REST uses OAuth 2 Bearer access tokens (short-lived; refresh tokens via OAuth). Content endpoints use https://content.dropboxapi.com/2.

notes: DubLab (dublab.app) AI dubbing SaaS. Docs: key in 'apikey' header; 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' also accepted. Endpoints: GET /me, POST /dubs, GET /dubs, GET /dubs/{id}. No MCP server found.

name: Excalidraw
description: Create and edit hand-drawn style diagrams, flowcharts and whiteboard sketches.
notes: Remote MCP answers initialize without auth (URL inferred, probe-verified). No public REST API. npm 'excalidraw-mcp' is a third-party package (not official).

name: Expedia
description: Search hotels, flights and travel packages and plan trips with Expedia.
notes: Directories list https://www.expedia.com/mcp (OAuth) but probe returned 403 with bot-protection body and no www-authenticate, so unverified. Expedia Group APIs (Rapid, developers.expediagroup.com) are partner-only, not self-serve API keys.

name: Facebook
description: Manage Meta ad campaigns, ad sets, creatives and insights, and work with Facebook Pages via the Graph API.

notes: Remote MCP URL found by probing the vendor domain. API: https://connectors.windsor.ai/{connector}?api_key=...&fields=...

name: Wispr Flow
description: Read Wispr Flow Notetaker meeting summaries, transcripts, scratchpad notes, tasks and calendar events.
notes: Requires Notetaker + Cloud Sync enabled. No public developer REST API found.

name: Wix
description: Manage Wix sites, stores, products, bookings, contacts and content.

secrets.name: WIX_API_KEY
secrets.label: API key
secrets.help: Wix account > API Keys Manager (also send wix-site-id or wix-account-id header)

notes: @wix/mcp is published by Wix CI (no env; flags like --tools/--portals).

name: WordPress
description: Create, edit and publish posts and pages, and manage media, comments and site settings.

secrets.name: WORDPRESS_BASE_URL
secrets.label: API base URL of your account

secrets.name: WORDPRESS_APP_PASSWORD
secrets.label: username:application password
secrets.help: WP admin > Users > Profile > Application Passwords

notes: Remote MCP is WordPress.com (enable under account 'AI and MCP'); URL found by probing, not seen in vendor docs. npm package (Automattic) bridges to self-hosted sites running the WordPress MCP plugin; also supports JWT_TOKEN.

name: WorkOS
description: Manage WorkOS organizations, users, SSO connections, directories and audit logs.
notes: Remote MCP URL found by probing the vendor domain (not confirmed in vendor docs).

name: Wrike
description: Create and update tasks, projects, folders and comments, and query work in Wrike.
notes: Vendor docs give remote MCP https://mcp.wrike.com/v2 (OAuth or PAT as Bearer), but probe returned '401 text/plain Unauthorized' with no www-authenticate, so not counted as verified.

name: X (Twitter)
description: Post, search and read tweets, look up users and manage engagement on X.

secrets.name: X_BEARER_TOKEN
secrets.label: Bearer token
secrets.help: developer.x.com > Projects & Apps > Keys and tokens

notes: Official XMCP (github.com/xdevplatform/xmcp) is Python, run locally; hosted api.x.com/mcp reported by third parties and confirmed by probe. Docs MCP at https://docs.x.com/mcp. User-context writes need OAuth 2.0.

name: YouTube
description: Search videos and channels and read video, playlist, comment and channel data.
notes: No official Google-hosted YouTube MCP found (mcp.youtube.com 502); only community servers. Uploads/account actions require OAuth.

name: Zapier
description: Run actions across thousands of apps connected to the user's Zapier account.
notes: Generate the MCP server token/URL at mcp.zapier.com. No general-purpose API-key REST API for running actions.

name: Zernio
description: Schedule and publish social posts across 15+ platforms, manage comments, DMs, ads and analytics.
notes: npm zernio-mcp is community (Eyalm321); official SDK is @zernio/node.

name: ZipRecruiter
description: Search live job listings by title, company, location, salary and work style.
notes: Hosted jobseeker MCP answers without auth; reportedly rate-limited. No public job-search REST API.

name: ZoomInfo
description: Search and enrich company and contact B2B data, intent signals and org charts.

secrets.name: ZOOMINFO_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.label: Access token (JWT)
secrets.help: Obtain via POST /authenticate with ZoomInfo API credentials (admin portal)

notes: Remote MCP URL found by probing the vendor domain. REST API uses short-lived JWT from username + password/private key, not a static key.
